Rationale: The cross-traffic vehicle is located 27 meters ahead and is moving laterally across the ego vehicle's path. Given the ego vehicle's speed of 30 kph (~8.3 m/s), it will reach the intersection in approximately 3.2 seconds. The cross-traffic vehicle, moving at 6 m/s from a lateral position of -7.0 m, will clear the immediate conflict zone (assuming a standard lane width) well before the ego vehicle arrives. Therefore, maintaining the current speed and trajectory (A0) is the appropriate action as there is no immediate physical conflict requiring braking or steering.
